# Parser test fixtures

Stat blocks pasted in the formats DMs actually use (D&D Beyond copy, book layout, Markdown links,
plain text), each checked by `run-parser.js` against `../expectations.json`.

**Invented test creatures** — written for these tests, not taken from any book:
`cairn_thane.txt`, `rimebone_sentinel.txt`, `homebrew_exclamation_names.txt`,
`homebrew_mixed_delimiters.txt`, `telepathy_only.txt`.

**SRD 5.2 creatures** — all the other fixtures.
